title: Hekatompedon temple

buildingCutout.basis: Remove the later Classical Parthenon’s mapped building and column parts only in this earlier view. The separate Old Temple of Athena and the Erechtheion lie beyond the cutout.

note: The reconstruction sits in the southwest portion of the current Parthenon platform, following the southern-site interpretation. The Protomaps Parthenon outline fixes that platform and its long axis. The ancient temple is aligned approximately parallel, with a 47.2 × 24 m stair envelope inside the southwest portion of the mapped footprint. Approximately align the foot of the temple steps to the median level of the retained Acropolis terrace. The bounded dated grade lowers the visible surface 0.25 m below the building origin to accommodate the viewer’s land-cover lift. Historical placement requires an explicit viewingDate within the recorded appearance interval; excluded from the default current world.
